questions.question: Discuss how enzymes increase the rate of a chemical reaction.
questions.solution_html:
• Enzyme definition- (1 mark); Activation energy and transition state- (3 marks)
  • Mention Enzyme substrate complex- (1 mark)
  • Mechanism: Enzymes act as biological catalysts by lowering the activation energy
  • required for a reaction to proceed. They provide an alternative reaction pathway where
  • the transition state is stabilized.
  • Binding: The formation of an Enzyme-Substrate (ES) complex at the active site
  • positions substrates in the optimal orientation for the reaction to occur.
questions.final_answer: positions substrates in the optimal orientation for the reaction to occur
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Write an account on molecular chaperones and their biological importance.
questions.solution_html:
• Definition and any 4 points- (4 marks); Examples- (1marks)
  • Liberal valuation
  • Chaperones are specialized proteins that assist in the correct folding of newly synthesized
  • polypeptide chains.
  • They prevent "misfolding" or aggregation of proteins, which is critical for maintaining
  • cellular health and preventing diseases like Alzheimer’s or Parkinson’s.
questions.final_answer: cellular health and preventing diseases like Alzheimer’s or Parkinson’s
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe β-oxidation of saturated fatty acids.
questions.solution_html:
• Definition- (1 mark); six steps- (3 marks); example (palmitic acid or any other)- (1 mark)
  • Process: This is the mitochondrial pathway for breaking down fatty acids into Acetyl
  • CoA units.
  • Stages: It involves a six-step cycle: 1. Activation of FA, 2. Carnitine shuttle, 3.
  • Desaturation, 4. Hydration 5. Oxidation (NAD-linked), and 6. Thiolysis. Each cycle
  • shortens the fatty acid chain by two carbons.
questions.final_answer: shortens the fatty acid chain by two carbons
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Summarize the importance of polysaccharides and stereoisomers.
questions.solution_html:
• Summarize the importance of polysaccharides and stereoisomers.
  • Liberal valuation
  • Definition of polysaccharides and sterioisomers: (2 marks)
  • Examples: (2 marks)
  • Importances: (1 mark)
  • Polysaccharides: Serve as structural components (cellulose in plants) or energy storage
  • (starch in plants, glycogen in animals). Stereoisomers: The spatial arrangement of atoms
  • (like D- vs L-glucose) is vital because biological systems and enzymes are stereospecific;
  • they usually only recognize one specific isomer.
questions.final_answer: Option (d) vs L-glucose) is vital because biological systems and enzymes are stereospecific;

questions.question: Explain uncompetitive inhibition and describe how it affects enzyme–substrate / complex formation.
questions.solution_html:

  • Definition: In this type of inhibition, the inhibitor binds only to the Enzyme-Substrate
